# AurumAI — AI Infrastructure and Funding Plan

Funding should increase AurumAI's ability to validate, reproduce, inspect, and operate institutional intelligence. It should not be justified by adding models merely because they are available.

## Priority 1 — Validation

- reproducible OOS evaluation;
- isolated runtime artifacts;
- immutable experiment records;
- automated regression validation;
- clean-clone CI;
- machine-readable validation reports.

## Priority 2 — Compute

Support historical replay, controlled experiments, forecasting experiments, justified NLP experiments, and batch evaluation.

## Priority 3 — Controlled AI research

External models may assist research, code review, document analysis, NLP, hypothesis generation, and experiment analysis. They must not become opaque authorities over the institutional decision path.

## Priority 4 — Data

Improve reliable market/economic data acquisition, historical archives, news archives, provenance, versioned datasets, and reproducible snapshots.

## Priority 5 — Operations

Later funding can support secure deployment, observability, artifact retention, access control, and audit logging.

## Priority 6 — Outcome evaluation and learning

Later funding can wire decision-to-realization outcome evaluation and controlled learning/calibration loops so recorded experiments become feedback evidence. No outcome-evaluation or learning path is wired into the current runtime.

## Work packages

| WP | Purpose | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| WP-01 | Validation infrastructure | reproducible runs |
| WP-02 | Data reliability | provenance + replay |
| WP-03 | Controlled AI research | reproducible model comparison |
| WP-04 | Compute/experiments | retained artifacts |
| WP-05 | Operations | audited deployment |
| WP-06 | Outcome evaluation + learning | recorded decision-outcome linkage per experiment |

No package authorizes live trading by itself.
